status: Retrospective internal study. All previously studied external folds are reused. Freeze this protocol and sources before evaluating any new selected support. No tuning.
donor: The 41 eligible original refit-guard folds, archived fit/proposal/guard rows, model seed 20421+fold, rare-class indicator, compact Gain anchor A and its order. Report the excluded red-wine fold and 13-complete-task sensitivity.
candidates: Use the distinct ceil(q |A|) strongest Gain prefixes for q=1/4,1/2,3/4,1; sort unique widths ascending. A always passes, even when all smaller candidates fail. Select smallest passing width.
model: Use the same fixed 100-tree, depth-4, single-thread CPU XGBoost. Median imputation fits on training rows of each stage only. Fit each distinct prefix once on archived fit + proposal; predict all disjoint guard rows. All rules share models and predictions.
panels: Panel 0 is every guard row once. A numpy default_rng(SeedSequence([20421+fold, 659])) draws three further class-stratified bootstrap panels, sampling n_c guard positions with replacement within each class c in encoded class order. Preserve counts, use all rows, share panel indices across all widths and methods. Repeated rows and votes are dependent.
votes: One global context: a yes requires all inherited metrics to pass (AUC and accuracy relative loss <=3%, rare-positive average precision <=5% where applicable). One context per observed training class: a yes requires that class's recall under the candidate on the same panel be at least 97% of anchor recall. Include numerical slack 1e-12; anchor recall zero imposes a vacuous constraint.

rules.global_point: One point-panel global vote, original refit-guard tolerance applied to this common prefix grid.
rules.class_point: Single point panel: global and every class vote must be yes.
rules.class_vote: For each context separately count yes across the four paired panels. Accept if and only if the minimum across the global and class counts is at least 3 of 4 (strict majority). The point panel is one of these four.
rules.anchor: Uncompressed reference within this experiment, the inherited compact Gain anchor.

efficiency: Count context-panel checks to deliberate at each candidate in fixed order (global then classes, point then bootstrap), rejecting as soon as any context cannot pass and accepting a context when enough yes votes have arrived. Verify this yields the same choice as the complete table. All shared inner fits are charged before decisions; no model-fit acceleration claim. Record actual shared component seconds and independent representative per-arm refit seconds where possible. Cached ballot construction is fully charged to the study, so counts are logical savings only.
evaluation: Write selection and digest before using the outer labels for scoring or fitting any development-set final model. Refit each distinct selected support and anchor once on full development, predict external test. Report task-equal averages of AUC, accuracy, balanced accuracy, retained fraction, and number of folds exceeding the original anchor tolerance (also class recall failures). Record choices for all folds. No p-values.
